facts.text: Snow left Snow Mountain (6,230 ft) 30 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Snow Mountain
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 17 (2023), April 26 (2024), May 4 (2025)

facts.text: At Snow Mountain (6,230 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.7 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Snow Mountain
evidence.detail: 0.7 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 20.7 in (2023), 11.8 in (2024), 22.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 21 and April 5, carried from the melt-out date at Snow Mountain (6,230 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Snow Mountain
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 2,047 ft above the pass; points to January 21 to April 5
